props.title: Pretend ==Pro== Suite
props.subtitle: All the gravitas of a pro console. None of the consequences.

slides.notes: Hook: everyone loves the way a mission-control console feels. This deck is about bottling that feeling as a toy.

props.label: The idea
props.text: The big screens. The dials. The ==mission-control energy==. Everybody loves the feeling of a high-stakes professional dashboard — so we made it a toy you can tap, flip, and perform with.

slides.notes: Land the thesis: it's the *feeling* of a pro console, kept and played with. Pause before moving on.
